definition: θριαμβεύω (θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus), __1. to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. Col.2:15, but see infr.).  __2. to lead in triumph: with accusative  of person(s), 2Co.2:14; hence, generally, to make a spectacle or show of: Col.2:15 (but see supr.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; and esp. Field, Notes, 181).† (AS)
